reference: Wang 2025 ANN-hard, Eqs. (1)-(9); TensorFlow mathematical implementation
target: direct raw G(Y_next), not a residual; no temperature or pressure output
loss: mean absolute error in raw G-space
optimizer: bias-corrected Adam, betas 0.9/0.999, epsilon 1e-8 outside sqrt(v_hat)
element_projection: paper direct 3x3 solve, no floor or positivity QP
temperature: Cantera HPY using current T/P/Y enthalpy and corrected next Y

assumptions.output_dimension: 9 species per Eq.(2); paper text also says 11 output neurons, unresolved author inconsistency
assumptions.input_scaling: train-only z-score, ddof0; raw T, linear P(atm), literal Box-Cox Y
assumptions.output_scaling: none, preserving stated G-space L1 objective
assumptions.initialization: PyTorch Linear default uniform distribution; backend random streams differ
assumptions.gelu: exact, matching PyTorch nn.GELU default; legacy repository settings instead use mygelu
assumptions.invalid_states: reject undefined inverse, singular projection, negative corrected Y, failed thermal recovery; no clipping
assumptions.adam_state_between_stages: retained; training source not released to confirm reset policy

intentional_data_exceptions: keep existing data, mechanism, initial-condition splits, downsampling and dt=2us per user
